answer: One fake is cheap, but 192 aliases need 192 independent work logs, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The mesa is the wall and the hollow is the gate: Use stonemason lodge tenure with cathedral work logs as the proof: masonry work logged at one site across many seasons. A farm of 192 aliases must climb the wall 192 times, the sonnet ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
